title: Charlie Parker, Dizzy Gillespie and bebop
summary: He never met Parker, was buddies with Dizzy, whom he told was spoiling musicians.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: While you were playing with Red, or while you were all playing around, I'm sure you must have bumped into musicians like Charlie Parker.
Never met Charlie Parker in my life.
Oh, yeah,he and I were buddies.
How about all the musicians who were around Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie, like the pianist Thelonious Monk? How did you feel about the music they were playing?

In the beginning I didn't like Dizzy's playing because he spoiled a whole lot of musicians. That's when this Juilliard thing started, you know, he'd put on his beret and go around with his horn and everyone wanted to do a Dizzy... I told him, "You're spoiling the other musicians. You're too great for that. You can play different." So he changed and then he went back again. He could play any style he wanted.
